honest.title: Honest network
honest.description: Everyone follows the rules. Orphans still appear because blocks take time to travel.

partition.title: Network partition
partition.description: The network splits in two, each half keeps mining, then it heals and the lighter side reorgs.

double_spend.title: Double spend (private fork)
double_spend.description: An attacker pays a merchant, secretly mines a conflicting fork, and publishes it after the goods ship.

selfish_mining.title: Selfish mining
selfish_mining.description: A miner withholds blocks and reveals them strategically to waste honest work and earn more than its share.
